topic: Service schedule by races and hours
statement: Suzuki's service schedule for the 2017 RM-Z450 counts one race as about 2 hours. Every race (2 hours): inspect the spark plug, clean the air filter, inspect the cooling system, clutch, cables, throttle body, fuel hose, muffler, brakes, fork, rear suspension, tires, spokes and steering, and re-tighten bolts and nuts (check them every hour). Every 3 races (6 hours): change the engine oil, inspect the oil strainers, replace the drive chain and the chain buffer and guide, change the fork oil and tighten the front brake caliper axle bolt. Every 6 races (12 hours): replace the oil filter, piston and piston ring (the silencer is also listed for replacement), and check valve clearance, cylinder head and cylinder. Adjust chain slack every 30 minutes of riding; check spokes every 20 minutes for the first 2 hours. Replace brake fluid, brake hoses, coolant and radiator hoses every year and the fuel hose every 4 years.

topic: Valve clearance, compression and top-end limits
statement: 2017 RM-Z450 top end: valve clearance cold is 0.09 to 0.16 mm intake and 0.17 to 0.24 mm exhaust. Compression is 300 kPa (43 psi) or more with the automatic decompressor working, which is why the reading looks low. Cylinder bore 96.000 to 96.015 mm; piston 95.960 to 95.975 mm measured 16 mm up from the skirt, limit 95.880 mm; piston-to-cylinder clearance 0.035 to 0.045 mm, limit 0.120 mm. Top ring end gap 0.20 to 0.30 mm, limit 0.50 mm. Piston pin 18.992 to 19.000 mm, limit 18.980 mm. Cam height: intake 35.58 to 35.63 mm (limit 35.28), exhaust 34.53 to 34.58 mm (limit 34.23). Cylinder head and cylinder distortion limit 0.05 mm. Valve spring free length limit 35.8 mm.

2017 RM-Z450 bottom end and clutch limits: crankshaft runout limit 0.08 mm; conrod big-end side clearance 0.20 to 0.65 mm, limit 1.0 mm; conrod small end limit 19.050 mm; conrod deflection limit 3.0 mm; crank web-to-web width 61.9 to 62.1 mm. Clutch: drive plate thickness 3.07 to 3.23 mm, limit 2.77 mm; claw width limit 13.05 mm; driven plate distortion limit 0.10 mm; spring free length 51.94 mm, limit 49.4 mm; lever free play 2 to 3 mm. Shift fork to groove clearance 0.1 to 0.3 mm, limit 0.5 mm. Oil pressure 50 kPa (7.1 psi) at 4,000 r/min with oil at 50 C.

The 2017 RM-Z450 runs 13/50 final gearing (3.846) with a 520 chain, DID 520MXV4, 114 links, and 35 to 45 mm of chain slack. Primary reduction 2.625 (63/24). Five-speed ratios: first 1.800, second 1.470, third 1.235, fourth 1.050, fifth 0.909. Replace the chain when the plate height wears to 12.75 mm inner or 11.20 mm outer.

topic: Oil, coolant, fuel and fluid capacities
statement: 2017 RM-Z450 fluids: engine oil SAE 10W-40, JASO MA; 1,050 ml at an oil change, 1,100 ml with the filter, 1,200 ml after an overhaul. Coolant 1,150 ml; radiator cap opens at 95 to 125 kPa (14 to 18 psi). Fuel tank 6.2 L (1.6 US gal); US bikes need at least 90 pump octane unleaded. Brake fluid DOT 4. Spark plug NGK DIMR8A10, gap 0.9 to 1.0 mm. Idle 2,100 plus or minus 50 r/min; throttle cable play 2 to 4 mm; throttle body 43 mm.

topic: Fork and shock standard settings, air pressure and oil
statement: Standard suspension on the 2017 RM-Z450 (Showa air fork, 49 mm, 310 mm travel; damping in the left leg, air spring in the right). Fork: rebound 13 clicks out, compression 8 clicks out, both counted from fully in. Right leg air pressure: inner chamber 1,200 kPa (171 psi), balance chamber 1,200 kPa (171 psi), outer chamber 0. Left leg 0. Fork oil Showa SS-19: left leg 320 ml in the outer tube and 314 ml in the damper unit; right leg 100 ml inner chamber, 250 ml outer chamber, 10 ml balance chamber. Shock: spring 55.9 N/mm (5.70 kgf/mm), rebound 12 clicks out, low-speed compression 12 clicks out, high-speed compression 2 turns out, gas pressure 784 to 980 kPa (112 to 139 psi), oil Showa SS-25, 383 ml. Rear wheel travel 310 mm.

2017 RM-Z450 wheels and brakes: rims 1.60 x 21 front and 2.15 x 19 rear; tires 80/100-21 and 110/90-19 (Bridgestone M403/M404 stock); cold pressure 70 to 110 kPa (10 to 16 psi) both ends. Brake disc thickness: front 3.0 mm, limit 2.5 mm; rear 4.0 mm, limit 3.5 mm; distortion limit 0.3 mm. Rim runout limit 2.0 mm; axle runout limit 0.25 mm. Rear brake pedal height 0 to 10 mm.

Engine torque values for the 2017 RM-Z450: cylinder head bolts 25 Nm then 51 Nm (37 lb-ft); head cover 14 Nm; cylinder base and head base bolts 10 Nm; camshaft holder bolts 10 Nm; spark plug 11 Nm (8 lb-ft); primary drive gear nut 110 Nm; magneto rotor nut 80 Nm; clutch hub nut 90 Nm; clutch spring bolts 10 Nm; cam chain tensioner cap bolt 23 Nm and mounting bolts 10 Nm; crankcase, clutch cover and magneto cover bolts 11 Nm; oil drain plug 12 Nm (8.5 lb-ft); oil filter cap bolts 11 Nm; oil strainer cap 21 Nm; engine sprocket bolt 32 Nm; exhaust pipe nuts 23 Nm; kick starter lever bolt 29 Nm; engine mounting bolt 55 Nm and mounting nuts 66 Nm.

Chassis torque values for the 2017 RM-Z450: rear axle nut 100 Nm (72.5 lb-ft); front axle nut 35 Nm (25.5 lb-ft); front axle holder bolts 21 Nm; fork clamp bolts, upper and lower, 23 Nm; handlebar clamp bolts 25 Nm; steering stem head nut 120 Nm; steering stem nut 45 Nm then back off 1/4 to 1/2 turn; front caliper mounting bolts 26 Nm; brake pad pins 18 Nm; brake hose union bolts 23 Nm; front disc bolts 11 Nm and rear 26 Nm; rear sprocket nuts 30 Nm; spoke nipples 6 Nm; rim lock 14 Nm front and 17 Nm rear; brake pedal pivot bolt 29 Nm.

topic: Electrical test values and wire colours
statement: Electrical tests for the 2017 RM-Z450 (there is no battery; a condenser stores charge). Crank position sensor 80 to 120 ohms between red and green, peak voltage 2.8 V or more. Charge coil 1.2 to 2.5 ohms between the two yellow leads. Ignition coil primary 0.17 to 0.70 ohms between white/blue and black/white; secondary 9 to 14 kilohms from the plug cap to black/white; primary peak voltage 170 V or more. Magneto no-load output 100 V AC or more at 5,000 r/min with a cold engine; regulated voltage 13.5 to 15.0 V at 5,000 r/min. Engine stop switch under 1 ohm between black/yellow and black/white when pressed; the holeshot (S-HAC) switch under 1 ohm between red/yellow and black/white. Ignition timing 12 degrees BTDC at 2,100 r/min. Injector 9.5 to 11.5 ohms at 20 C; fuel pressure about 294 kPa (42 psi); fuel pump delivers 89 ml or more in 10 seconds.

Sensor reference values for the 2017 RM-Z450: every sensor supply is 4.5 to 5.5 V. Throttle position sensor output 0.60 to 0.64 V closed and 3.60 to 4.00 V open. Intake air pressure sensor output 0.98 to 2.86 V at idle. Coolant temperature sensor about 2.58 kilohms at 20 C, 0.77 at 50 C and 0.28 at 80 C. Intake air temperature sensor about 2.58 kilohms at 20 C. Tip-over sensor about 19.4 kilohms; 0.4 to 1.4 V upright and 3.7 to 4.4 V leaned 65 degrees. Gear position switch 0.6 V or more in every gear.

topic: Fault codes, how they flash and limp-home behaviour
statement: Fault codes on the 2017 RM-Z450 flash on the indicator light as long and short flashes, lowest code first: 12 crank position sensor, 14 throttle position sensor, 15 coolant temperature sensor, 17 intake air pressure sensor, 21 intake air temperature sensor, 23 tip-over sensor, 24 ignition signal (ignition coil), 31 gear position switch, 32 fuel injector, 41 fuel pump control (ECM). 00 means no fault. With a failed sensor the bike still starts and runs on fixed values: intake pressure 106 kPa, throttle treated as closed with fixed timing, coolant 80 C, intake air 15 C, gear treated as first. To clear codes after a repair, disconnect the battery lead used for diagnosis and reconnect it.
